speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To help me understand your condition, how long has this been going on, and was there any meconium staining in the amniotic fluid during birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity (33 weeks gestation).

Given the history of prematurity and the timing of symptoms, I need to confirm the clinical picture. Do you observe grunting, nasal flaring, or retractions, and has the baby been given any oxygen therapy so far?
